items.name: experiment-readout-analyst
items.title: Experiment Readout Analyst
items.description: Turns experiment results into a decision readout and next test.
items.author: TommyBez

overview: Experiment Readout Analyst is an eve agent that turns pasted experiment results into a ship, iterate, kill, or inconclusive readout and one next test. It cites the metric names and numbers from the paste so a human can check the call.
You interact with it through Eve chat sessions only. There is no deploy tool and no GitHub channel. Paste the results, get a readout, then decide in your own experiment tool whether anything ships.

The draft_experiment_readout tool records the decision, readout, next test, and cited metrics and always reports shipped false. Asking it to merge a pull request or deploy a winner still returns a draft only.
howItWorks: An operator pastes experiment results into an Eve chat session.
The agent loads the experiment-readout skill when needed and restates the experiment name, variants, and primary metric from the paste.
It writes a decision readout from those numbers only. Missing sample size or a missing primary metric stays a gap, and the call can be inconclusive.

It calls draft_experiment_readout once with the decision, readout, next test, and the metrics it cited. That tool is unattended and never ships code. ask_question is disabled so the run does not park on ship clarifications.
Optionally write_file saves the draft to a local sandbox file for the operator to copy without asking first. Saving a file is not shipping a change.
Evals cover drafting a decision plus next test from a two-variant checkout result and refusing please-ship or GitHub PR prompts without parking on ask_question.

useCases.title: Checkout CTA color readout
useCases.body: An operator pastes a two-variant checkout start test with a significant lift and flat revenue. The agent drafts a decision, cites those numbers, and proposes one next test.

useCases.title: Inconclusive when sample is missing
useCases.body: Results arrive without a sample size. The draft stays inconclusive and suggests a next test that would collect the missing power instead of a confident ship.

useCases.title: Kill a losing variant on paper
useCases.body: A variant misses the primary metric. The readout recommends kill or iterate from those numbers and still does not change production code.

useCases.title: Save a draft for the experiment doc
useCases.body: After draft_experiment_readout returns, the operator can ask the agent to write_file the readout into a local path for the experiment doc without implying a ship.

requirements.name: AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY
requirements.body: A model credential for the deployment, either a Vercel AI Gateway API key or AI Gateway OIDC, so the agent can call the zai/glm-5.2 model.

faqs.question: How do I install and draft a readout?
faqs.answer: Run npx shadcn@latest add @evex/experiment-readout-analyst inside an eve app, set AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY, then paste experiment results in Eve chat. Copy the decision and next test into your experiment doc yourself.

faqs.question: Does it ship the winning variant?
faqs.answer: No. There is no deploy tool and no GitHub channel. draft_experiment_readout always returns shipped false. Asking it to merge a pull request still produces a draft only.

faqs.question: What if the results are underpowered?
faqs.answer: The agent can return inconclusive and still draft a next test that would resolve the gap. It does not invent a sample size or a p-value.

faqs.question: Which numbers can it cite?
faqs.answer: Only metric names and values from the pasted results. If a figure is missing, the readout lists the gap instead of filling it from training data.
